verdict.rationale: LangGraph natively supports multi-agent orchestration patterns (handoffs, subagents, custom workflows) documented explicitly in the multi-agent guide, backed by graph/node composition, state sharing, checkpointing, and interrupts for human-in-the-loop coordination. Community evidence corroborates it as a legitimate stateful workflow engine (Pregel-based) suited for complex multi-node/agent orchestration, though some note complexity and rough edges in streaming/deployment.
